note: Portable Seed-VC SVC knobs for the imitation pass. Actor take (accent + emotion) is the source; curated character WAV is timbre only. Machine paths live in env or seedvc-imitation-defaults.local.json. Do not turn f0_condition off. Do not use app_vc.py, inference_v2.py, or seed_vc_wrapper.py.

actorNote.es: El actor imita el acento objetivo. auto_f0_adjust está encendido por defecto: asienta el contorno emocional en el registro del personaje. Apágalo en el panel si ya coincidiste el tono a mano. Decisión: A/B Elin y Zao ES del 2026-09-06.
actorNote.en: The actor imitates the target accent. auto_f0_adjust defaults on: it seats the emotional contour in the character's range. Turn it off in the panel if you already matched pitch by ear. Decision: 2026-09-06 Elin and Zao ES A/B.
